subject: [PATCH 04/12] mm/collapse: add collapse.h for the collapse interface

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch adds a new header file, mm/collapse.h, to separate the interface and state of the collapse mechanism from its implementation in khugepaged.c. The new header defines an enum for scan results and a struct for control data, as well as two constants that were previously defined in khugepaged.c. This separation is intended to clarify the distinction between users and implementers of the collapse interface.
